1018-5612-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
1018-5612-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Kudo, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Skullwinder token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1753-2105-3603-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
1753-2105-3603-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1753-2105-3603-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Cloudshift from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Cloudshift from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

222-527-1849-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1849-8249.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Defiant Salvager twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1981-2415-6094-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5870-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5870-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

2085-2645-3430-5233.easyPrerequisites: Kelpie Guide doesn't have summoning sickness.
2085-2645-3430-5233.description:
Activate Boros Garrison by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping Boros Garrison
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

654-851-1308-4094-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
654-851-1308-4094-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

2757-4365-5285.description:
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating two creature tokens due to Mondrak.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic Plains
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

301-345-2813.easyPrerequisites: There's an artifact on the battlefield.
301-345-2813.description:
Activate Goblin Trashmaster by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
Resolve the Goblin Trashmaster ability.
Repeat.

3764-7363-7426.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token and a Mutagen token due to Donatello.
Activate the Mutagen by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Mutagen ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

372-1567-7487.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Momentary Blink exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1567-7487.description:
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Zealous Lorecaster and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Zealous Lorecaster trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Momentary Blink from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Momentary Blink.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Zealous Lorecaster and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6556-7328.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-6556-7328.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Donatello triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Donatello.
Repeat.

104-1308-4050-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-1308-4050-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

4002-4331-4993-5705.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
4002-4331-4993-5705.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {1}.
Glaring Fleshraker triggers, creating an Eldrazi Spawn token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Manifold Key enters.
Repeat.

57-4235-4846-6633.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4235-4846-6633.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

573-826-1399-1606.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Gruul Turf.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2

4050-4616-5544-6822.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Lyla triggers, targeting a creature an opponent controls.
Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Lyla trigger.
Repeat.

2743-6198-6570.description:
Cast Mnemonic Deluge by paying {6}{U}{U}{U}, exiling Self-Reflection and casting three copies of it without paying their mana costs.
Resolve the three Self-Reflection copies, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

411-2646-4103-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have cycled Yidaro at least three times this game.
411-2646-4103-4613.description:
Activate Yidaro's cycling ability by paying {1}{R} and discarding it.
Yidaro triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Resolve the Yidaro cycling ability, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yidaro using Grinning Ignus's ability by paying {1} and returning Yidaro from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat.

2351-2757-4639.notablePrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
There is a basic land on the battlefield.
2351-2757-4639.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Earthcraft by tapping a blue creature you control except Unctus.
The creature triggers, causing you to loot.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability.
Repeat.

1247-5536-5821.notablePrerequisites:
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Fyndhorn Elder and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
1247-5536-5821.description:
Activate Rex using Fyndhorn Elder's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1661-5078-5705.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat

215-380-1418-5130.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional artifact, enchantment and/or token.
215-380-1418-5130.description:
Cast Realm-Scorcher Hellkite by paying {4}{R}{R} and sacrificing another artifact, enchantment or token.
When Realm-Scorcher Hellkite enters the battlefield, it and Miirym trigger twice.
Resolve both Realm-Scorcher Hellkite triggers, adding {5}{R}{R}{G}.
Resolve both Miirym triggers, creating two token copies of Realm-Scorcher Hellkite.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Realm-Scorcher Hellkite to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

3327-3719-4881.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed a number of artifacts and/or creatures this turn equal to the number of times you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game minus one.
3327-3719-4881.description:
Cast Dargo by paying {R} and sacrificing Ruthless Technomancer.
Cast Activated Sleeper by paying {2}{B}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Dargo and create seven Treasure tokens.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}{R}.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Activated Sleeper by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasures, returning Ruthless Technomancer from your graveyard to the battelfield.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Dargo and create seven Treasure tokens.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}{R}.
Cast Dargo by paying {R} and sacrificing Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 6.

232-2136-2178-5231.notablePrerequisites: Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
232-2136-2178-5231.description:
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask with haste.
When the token Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Priest of Urabrask token, adding {R}.
When the Priest of Urabrask token dies, Orthion triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead use Orthion's second ability to make copies of any creature(s) you control.

2781-5210-5256.notablePrerequisites: Liliana has at least four loyalty counters on it.
2781-5210-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Felidar Guardian, causing target player to mill cards equal to Felidar Guardian's power.
Activate Liliana's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, blinking Liliana.
Repeat.

907-1479-3585.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1479-3585.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Greensleeves, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Greensleeves trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

24-1981-3333.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, selecting an arbitrarily large number, and dealing that much damage to you if you chose the largest number.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Soldier creature tokens equal to the amount of damage dealt this way.
If you didn't choose the largest number, Wheel of Misfortune deals that much damage to each opponent who chose the largest number.

643-2692-3510.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
643-2692-3510.description:
Play any land from your hand.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Felidar Retreat, creating a 2/2 Cat Beast creature token.
The Cat Beast enters the battlefield as a Saproling due to Maskwood Nexus, which also causes it to be a Forest land due to Life and Limb.
Felidar Retreat triggers, creating a 2/2 Cat Beast creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

1323-3181-3995.notablePrerequisites:
Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
You control up to three lands that can produce a total of at least {1}{U}{U}.
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
1323-3181-3995.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj's own ability by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Horseshoe Crab.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj's own ability by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Krosan Restorer.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Krosan Restorer's ability by tapping it, untapping up to three lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Experiment Kraj's own ability any number of times, and potentially activate Experiment Kraj any number of times copying abilities of other creatures you have placed +1/+1 counters onto.
